answer: Hypothesis: The two documentation formats least used for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are **BDD Scenarios** (Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios, least used) and **ML Canvas** (Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas, second least used). In the supplied survey data (276 respondents; 194 valid after excluding 82 rows with NA code '-77' in the Q10 documentation block), only 4/194 valid respondents indicated BDD Scenarios (2.062%; 95% bootstrap CI [0.516, 4.124]) and 15/194 indicated ML Canvas (7.732%; 95% bootstrap CI [4.124, 11.856]) — the two lowest usage rates among the 10 concrete formats (bootstrap: nonparametric, respondent-level resampling, B = 10,000, seed 42, percentile 2.5/97.5). This rank order matches the study-reported reference values of 10.13% (95% CI [9.926, 10.333]) for the second-least-used format (ML Canvas) and 4.366% (95% CI [4.231, 4.501]) for the least-used format (BDD Scenarios). 'Not_Documented' (absence, not a format) and the catch-all 'Others' (ties ML Canvas at 15 quoted; free-text entries are tools such as Jira, Confluence, Notion, wiki — not a named format) are excluded from the selection, and the ranking is unchanged under the /276-all-respondents denominator sensitivity. The supplied export encodes Q10 as binary 'quoted'/'not quoted' with NA code -77, so the exact reference percentages and their narrow CIs are not reproducible from this export; the match is by rank order of usage.

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD Scenarios (least used; study-reported 4.366%, 95% CI [4.231, 4.501]; data-computed 2.062%, 95% bootstrap CI [0.516, 4.124]) and ML Canvas (second least used; study-reported 10.13%, 95% CI [9.926, 10.333]; data-computed 7.732%, 95% bootstrap CI [4.124, 11.856]), based on Q10_ML_Documentation_BDD_Scenarios and Q10_ML_Documentation_MLCanvas among 194 valid respondents (276 total, 82 excluded via NA code '-77').
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 rows x 202 cols); identified the 12 Q10_ML_Documentation_* columns as binary 'quoted'/'not quoted' with NA code '-77' (82 rows, identical across columns) -> valid N = 194. 2) Computed per-format usage percentages = quoted/194 (primary) and quoted/276 (sensitivity). 3) Excluded Not_Documented (not a format) and Others (catch-all; free-text = Jira/Confluence/Notion/wiki) and ranked the 10 concrete formats: BDD_Scenarios (4, 2.062%) < MLCanvas (15, 7.732%) < Vision_Document = Goal_Models (29) < ... < Notebooks (66, 34.021%); verified the ranking is invariant under the /276 denominator. 4) Nonparametric bootstrap of each format's proportion: resampling unit = respondent (row), with replacement, n = 194, B = 10,000, seed = 42 (np.random.default_rng), CI = empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles. 5) Matched the two least-used formats to the study-reported reference values by rank order (MLCanvas <-> 10.13% [9.926, 10.333]; BDD_Scenarios <-> 4.366% [4.231, 4.501]) and documented that the binary export does not allow exact reproduction of those values/CIs.
